verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an API endpoint for creating API keys, and the docs state these can be project-level keys. That gives some resource scoping a user could apply to an agent's credential. Nothing documents fine-grained permission scopes, read-only or role-limited keys, expiry, or agent-specific credential issuance, so least privilege is only partly shown. Missing for 10: per-permission or action scopes, read-only/role-restricted keys, key expiry/rotation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Create a new API key. When using API key authentication, only project-level API keys can be created.
